FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 181
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Merika Coleman
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/27/2026
Senate Bill 181 as introduced would codify the existing practice of the Administrative Office of
Courts to transfer state funds to a non-profit entity for judicial education and allow this entity to
collect nonpublic funds.
This bill would not otherwise directly affect state or local funding.
